:::{#sponsor-profile}

HASH is an open-source platform that helps organizations convert structured data and unstructured information alike into a strongly typed, temporal, semantic graph that is useful for process optimization and automation, as well as decision-support. HASH is also developing a "Process Foundation Model" designed to zero-shot generalize to real-world business processes with a far greater degree of accuracy than current frontier AI.
